title: What Haptic Programming Tools Is
definition: Haptic Programming Tools: programming with touch feedback.
description:
Haptic Programming Tools is programming with touch feedback. It sits squarely in Future Software Paradigms, the frontier where haptic APIs science becomes tool logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are device support-scale. Societies that master tool hulls early will shape force models practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why haptic APIs programs worldwide now treat Haptic Programming Tools as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Haptic Programming Tools needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Haptic Programming Tools
title: Real Research Today: Haptic Programming Tools
definition: Today's documented research behind Haptic Programming Tools.
description:
The road to Haptic Programming Tools is already being paved. Live programming environments (Bret Victor's heritage, Hazel) collapse the edit-compile gap. Formal methods adoption grows in aerospace (NASA), chips (Intel/ARM) and crypto protocols.

WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. Together these programs form the haptic APIs foundation that Haptic Programming Tools will build on — the tool logistics results, the force models methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as tool logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Haptic Programming Tools Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Haptic Programming Tools operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Haptic Programming Tools installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 4694 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where haptic APIs monitoring, tool logistics redundancy, or force models maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Haptic Programming Tools Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Haptic Programming Tools: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Haptic Programming Tools — programming with touch feedback.

Phase 1 — Prove (haptic APIs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (tool logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (force models): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (device support): tool hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
